description:
Are you passionate about digital marketing, communications, and content creation and ready to turn your ideas into real-world experience?

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Intern to support our Communications & Marketing initiatives across North America.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience supporting digital campaigns, creating content, coordinating projects, analyzing marketing performance, and contributing to employee engagement and communication initiatives.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Mexico and the United States, gaining exposure to an international environment while having the opportunity to take ownership of small projects and develop your professional skills.

What will you do?


Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns.
Create and edit engaging content for internal and external communication channels, including email communications, newsletters, social media, and web content.
Assist in developing marketing materials and presentations.
Support website content updates and digital asset management.
Monitor campaign performance and prepare basic analytics and performance reports.
Conduct market research and identify digital marketing trends and best practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to coordinate marketing and communication initiatives across North America.
Assist with project tracking, documentation, and follow-up for ongoing marketing projects.
Support employee engagement, communication, and brand awareness initiatives.
Take ownership of small projects with guidance from experienced team members.


What are we looking for?


Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field.
Advanced English proficiency, both written and verbal, is required, as you will collaborate with teams and stakeholders across North America.
Previous exposure to digital marketing or communications through internships, academic projects, freelance work, student organizations, or similar activities.
Strong interest in Digital Marketing, Marketing Communications, and Content Creation.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Creativity and attention to detail.
Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Proactive attitude, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural and cross-functional environment.


Portfolio

We would love to see what you have created!

Please share a portfolio or digital book of work showcasing relevant projects in areas such as content creation, social media, communications, design, or digital marketing campaigns.

Academic, personal, freelance, and student organization projects are welcome.

Tools & Skills

Exposure to some of the following areas or tools is a plus:


Digital Marketing & Marketing Communications
Content Creation & Social Media
Marketing Analytics & Reporting
Campaign Coordination & Project Management
Canva
Google Analytics
Eloqua or other email marketing platforms
Adobe Creative Suite
Microsoft Office and Copilot


You don't need to be an expert in every tool — we are looking for someone with a strong learning mindset and the motivation to develop these skills.

What will you gain?

International exposure: Collaborate with teams across Mexico and the United States and gain experience working in a global environment.

Hands-on experience: Contribute to real marketing and communications initiatives rather than simply observing from the sidelines.

Ownership: Take responsibility for small projects and see your work move from idea to execution.

Learning & development: Build practical skills in digital marketing, communications, analytics, content creation, and project coordination.

Mentorship: Learn from experienced professionals who will provide guidance throughout your internship.

Networking: Build relationships across teams and expand your professional network within a global organization.

Competitive internship stipend.

Ready to start building your career in Digital Marketing? We'd love to hear from you!

title: Account Management Assistant (mexico)
description:
Channel Factory provides intelligent marketing solutions for the next generation of contextual safety, suitability, and performance for brands and agencies. Our platform helps marketers implement, automate, and scale their marketing programs across the world's largest video library, You Tube and emerging growth channels. We sit at the intersection of marketing and suitability and have a mission of enabling the world's top brands to consciously connect with the right audience in the right context, maximizing suitability and contextual performance. Channel Factory embodies a strong start‑up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results. Our bias towards execution balances critical thinking, analysis, and pragmatic problem solving. We expect a lot from one another and value our thoughtful and intellectually curious company culture. The Assistant Account Manager will be an eager to learn professional, seeking to learn and grow and become the expert in the video marketing offerings and capabilities of You Tube and off-You Tube platforms. Through meticulous attention to detail, he/she can manage multiple complex projects with ease – whether they call for organizational skills, statistical analysis, or business acumen – and is always ready and excited to hit the ground running. The primary responsibility of the role is to assist Channel Factory's Account Manager in daily deliverables needed from clients or internal projects.

Responsibilities Compiling insightful weekly, monthly, and/or Final Reports in MS Excel or MS Powerpoint

Minute note-taker for POD meetings

Submitting IOs for signature and inputting details into SFDC

Tracking performance, delivery, and margin goals for the POD to ensure we are on track with goals & benchmarks

Assisting with ad-hoc client requests with Account Manager leading client communication

Developing targeting lists by audience and brand relevancy

Leading campaign screenshots for proof of purchase with clients

Researching and staying up to date with relevant trends

Working with the Designer in creating brand safe screenshots for campaign POPs

Monitoring pacing and margin reports for regional campaigns

Assisting in special projects as assigned by AM-MGMT

All other duties assigned Requirements Fluency in English both written and verbal

EXPERIENCE: 0‑1 years of digital media experience

Strong work ethic & discipline to work productively in a remote environment

Proficiency in video conferencing and messaging apps e.g., Zoom, Google Hangouts, Slack

Advanced knowledge of Excel calculations, pivot tables, and graphs is a must!

Bonus points if you are Ad Words or You Tube certified!

Have a thirst to learn the digital landscape and share with the team

A self‑directed professional who knows what needs to be done and operates with a sense of urgency, focus, and discipline

Able to effectively prioritize and work with little to no supervision

Highly organized and detail‑oriented professional

Have strong communication skills; verbal, written, interpersonal, and presentation

A collaborative individual who can work both in a team and independently

Driven and determined to learn and adapt in a face‑paced digital world

Above all, possess the highest levels of professionalism, integrity, and ethics Benefits Work with a leading startup in a high‑demand industry, and you would be working with like‑minded experts aiming to transform video ad operations

Competitive salary

Work‑life flexibility – we value your contributions above all About Channel Factory

Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award‑winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize You Tube advertising. Recognized as a technology innovator by Cynopsis and one of the fastest‑growing companies by Inc., Channel Factory has served over three hundred of the Fortune 500 in delivering scalable, brand‑safe, contextually aligned You Tube advertising software and services. By tapping into the deepest proprietary data pool on the market, the company enables highly customized, contextually aware, and dynamically optimized campaigns and provides industry‑leading performance for a portfolio of clients across all industries. Channel Factory is an equal‑opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Channel Factory makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. description:
Cardiometabolic Marketing Department

Mexico City

Help millions of people discover the care they need – by driving the campaigns that connect them to treatments that can change their lives. In this role, you'll be at the intersection of data, marketing, and purpose, coordinating consumer acquisition efforts in one of the fastest-growing therapy areas in healthcare.

Your new role

As a Consumer Acquisition Coordinator within the Cardiometabolic Marketing area, you will play a hands-on role in bringing consumer acquisition and retention campaigns to life – ensuring every initiative is executed with precision, informed by data, and aligned to our mission of reaching more patients than ever before.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Coordinating the end-to-end execution of targeted consumer acquisition and retention campaigns, ensuring milestones and deliverables are met on time
Monitoring campaign performance indicators and analyzing consumer and market data to identify trends, insights, and opportunities for optimization
Supporting audience segmentation strategies and A/B testing to refine targeting and improve engagement outcomes
Managing vendor coordination, budget tracking, and documentation to keep programs running efficiently and transparently
Facilitating cross-functional collaboration with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaign materials and required review processes are aligned
Compiling and delivering performance reports that enable data-informed decision-making and continuous improvement across acquisition programs


Your new department

Based in Mexico City, this team is passionate about reaching consumers who can benefit from innovative treatments – combining strategic thinking with disciplined campaign execution to drive meaningful engagement and business growth. As one of two Consumer Acquisition Coordinators joining the team, you will be part of a collaborative group that values precision, curiosity, and a shared commitment to making a tangible difference for patients across the region.

Your Skills & Qualifications

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced marketing environment and is energized by turning data into action. To succeed in this role, you will bring:


A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
2+ years of experience in consumer marketing, digital campaign coordination, or acquisition marketing – experience in healthcare or pharmaceuticals is a plus
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across functions and coordinating with external vendors or agency partners
Advanced proficiency in both English and Spanish is required


Working at Novo Nordisk

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Deadline

16 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

title: Junior / Semi Senior Marketing Analyst
description:
Azumo is looking for a highly motivated AI-Powered Marketing Analyst to join our marketing team and help grow the Azumo brand and business.

The role is fully remote across Latin America , aligned to your working day.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, curious, and already uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms as part of their daily work.

This is a practical, execution-focused role covering content, social media, AI search visibility, marketing analytics, and marketing operations. You will use AI throughout your workflow to research, create, design, analyze, automate, and improve marketing initiatives.

Your focus will be Azumo. You will learn about our business, customers, services, and market and use that knowledge to expand our reach, strengthen our brand, and generate new opportunities.

You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams and have access to leading paid AI, marketing, content, analytics, and creative tools.

What We’re Looking For

We care about how you work, not just which tools you have used.

We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into something real. You should be comfortable researching a topic, creating the content and visuals, publishing or launching the work, measuring the results, and improving the next iteration.

AI should already be a natural part of that process for you.

At the same time, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and publishes it. Strong judgment, creativity, attention to quality, and an understanding of the audience are essential.

Azumo offers an opportunity to build your marketing career inside a technology company where AI is part of the everyday work.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Access leading paid AI, marketing, analytics, content, and creative tools.

Work across social media, content, analytics, GEO/AEO, and emerging AI marketing channels.

Experiment with new tools and approaches in real marketing initiatives.

Focus on growing one company and one brand: Azumo.

Work Closely With Experienced Team Members And Company Leadership

Take ownership of projects and see the direct impact of your work.

Receive training and mentored career development.

Develop skills in emerging areas of marketing as AI changes how people search, discover, and evaluate companies.

Responsibilities

As part of the Azumo marketing team, you will:

Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools daily for research, content creation, creative development, analysis, and marketing operations.

Create and repurpose content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, including posts, graphics, carousels, and short-form content.

Create AI-generated images, videos, and other visual content using modern AI creative tools.

Develop and improve articles, case studies, newsletters, presentations, one-pagers, landing pages, and other marketing assets.

Implement GEO and AEO strategies to improve Azumo’s visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Monitor how Azumo and its competitors appear across traditional and AI search, identify content gaps, and turn those insights into actionable content improvements.

Use AI and analytics tools to build recurring reports covering traffic, social media, campaigns, leads, conversions, AI search visibility, and other relevant marketing KPIs.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve existing workflows.

Help maintain and update Azumo’s website when needed.

Support other marketing initiatives in collaboration with the marketing, sales, and leadership teams.

Requirements

Mandatory Qualifications

Expert-level English proficiency, both written and conversational.

3+ years of hands-on marketing experience, along with practical experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.

Strong, well-rounded understanding of marketing language, principles and strategy.

Experience creating content for LinkedIn and other social media channels, such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Reddit, or similar platforms.

Comfortable working with marketing data, KPIs, reporting, and performance analysis.

Strong judgment, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to improve AI-generated work before publication.

Ability to evaluate marketing ideas critically and distinguish between activity, engagement, and meaningful business impact.

Other Qualifications

Ability to connect marketing activities to business objectives and understand how different marketing channels work together.

Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar generative AI tools for research, content creation, design, video production, analysis and marketing operations.

Working experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of projects in a remote environment.

Understanding of GEO, AEO, SEO, and AI search visibility.

Experience with paid advertising, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads, or emerging AI advertising platforms.

Experience with Webflow or a similar website content management system.

Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Webmaster Tools and similar analytics platforms.

Experience creating AI-assisted workflows or marketing automations.

The AI-Powered Marketing Analyst will work remotely. Compensation will be commensurate with experience and candidate potential.

Company Benefits Include

Paid time off

100% remote-first culture (work anywhere in Latin America)

U.S. Holidays

Training

Mentored career development

USD remuneration

Profit Share Program

Access to premium AI and marketing tools

Maternity coverage

Based in San Francisco, California, Azumo is a software development company helping organizations build intelligent applications using modern technologies in AI, data, cloud, web, and mobile.

We work with organizations around the world and believe that great talent can come from anywhere.

At Azumo, we strive for excellence and strongly believe in professional and personal growth. We want each individual to be successful and aim to help each person achieve their goals while at Azumo and beyond.

skills: Own the analysis and strategy for the Google Ads program: what to test, what to scale, and what to cut.
Raise the account's Quality Score by improving ad relevance and landing page experience.
Own conversion tracking and feed the account lower-funnel signals, so it optimizes toward high-quality leads and not just form fills.
Coordinate our paid marketing agency: set priorities, brief the work, review what they ship, and hold the bar on quality and pace.
Dig into the data (search terms, Quality Score, lead quality) to separate what works from what is waste, and turn it into a clear plan.
Get hands-on in the account when needed: restructure ad groups, add negatives, adjust bids, fix tracking.

Use AI tools like Claude to work faster and sharper: structure and analyze data, pressure-test your hypotheses, and move from insight to decision in less time. The judgment stays yours; the tools just let you cover more ground.
Run a continuous testing agenda and report performance clearly: what changed, what it moved, and what is next.
Within your first few months, Quality Score is trending up and high-quality leads are a bigger share of the mix.
The agency runs smoothly under you: clear priorities, fast turnarounds, and work that meets your bar.
Your reporting is the source of truth the team trusts to decide where paid search goes next.
2+ years of hands-on Google Ads / paid search, ideally in lead generation, with results you can point to.
Advanced, near-native English, written and spoken. You will write ad copy and reports for a US audience.
Real fluency with the Google Ads account structure: match types, Smart Bidding, conversion actions, and search-terms analysis.
You are comfortable with data: you pull the numbers, read them, and turn them into a decision without hand-holding.
Strong spreadsheet skills, non-negotiable. We work in Google Sheets, and if you are not fluent with pivot tables, conditional functions, and lookups (VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP), this is not the role for you.
A bias for action and strong ownership. You move fast, document your work, and do not need to be chased.
Clear communication. You can explain a tradeoff to someone who does not live in the account.
Performance Max and broader Google campaign types.
Solid GA4, including conversion tracking setup and QA.
Building or iterating landing pages (we use Lovable) and improving conversion rate with tools like Microsoft Clarity.
Familiarity with B2B marketing.
Basic SQL or a data background, a plus and not a requirement.
Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.

Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.
description:
Who We Are

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

About The Role

This is first and foremost an analysis and strategy role, and it sits on top of one of the most important conversion channels we have. You own the thinking behind the account: what to test, what to cut, and how to push toward the leads most likely to become customers. Because paid search drives so much of our inbound pipeline, this is a high-visibility, high-impact seat, and what you decide here shows up directly in the numbers the business watches.

Day-to-day execution largely sits with our paid marketing agency, so a big part of the job is coordinating them well: setting priorities, briefing the work, reviewing what they ship, and holding the bar on quality and pace. It is not a hands-off role, though. You should be ready to get into the account yourself when a change needs to move fast or be done right. The mission is clear: use lower-funnel conversion signals to bring in better, higher-quality leads.

You will work directly with the performance marketing lead and move fast. We lean on AI tools to work smarter, so expect them to be part of how you do the job every day.

What You'll Do


Own the analysis and strategy for the Google Ads program: what to test, what to scale, and what to cut.
Raise the account's Quality Score by improving ad relevance and landing page experience.
Own conversion tracking and feed the account lower-funnel signals, so it optimizes toward high-quality leads and not just form fills.
Coordinate our paid marketing agency: set priorities, brief the work, review what they ship, and hold the bar on quality and pace.
Dig into the data (search terms, Quality Score, lead quality) to separate what works from what is waste, and turn it into a clear plan.
Get hands-on in the account when needed: restructure ad groups, add negatives, adjust bids, fix tracking.
Use AI tools like Claude to work faster and sharper: structure and analyze data, pressure-test your hypotheses, and move from insight to decision in less time. The judgment stays yours; the tools just let you cover more ground.
Run a continuous testing agenda and report performance clearly: what changed, what it moved, and what is next.


What Success Looks Like


Within your first few months, Quality Score is trending up and high-quality leads are a bigger share of the mix.
The agency runs smoothly under you: clear priorities, fast turnarounds, and work that meets your bar.
Your reporting is the source of truth the team trusts to decide where paid search goes next.


What We Are Looking For


2+ years of hands-on Google Ads / paid search, ideally in lead generation, with results you can point to.
Advanced, near-native English, written and spoken. You will write ad copy and reports for a US audience.
Real fluency with the Google Ads account structure: match types, Smart Bidding, conversion actions, and search-terms analysis.
You are comfortable with data: you pull the numbers, read them, and turn them into a decision without hand-holding.
Strong spreadsheet skills, non-negotiable. We work in Google Sheets, and if you are not fluent with pivot tables, conditional functions, and lookups (VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP), this is not the role for you.
A bias for action and strong ownership. You move fast, document your work, and do not need to be chased.
Clear communication. You can explain a tradeoff to someone who does not live in the account.


Nice to have


Performance Max and broader Google campaign types.
Solid GA4, including conversion tracking setup and QA.
Building or iterating landing pages (we use Lovable) and improving conversion rate with tools like Microsoft Clarity.
Familiarity with B2B marketing.
Basic SQL or a data background, a plus and not a requirement.


Tools you will use 

Google Ads, GA4, Google Sheets, Lovable for landing pages, Microsoft Clarity, and Claude for scaled execution.

Why join us 


Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. 
Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.


What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Mexico CIty office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

skills: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform

Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

description:
Leave a MARK.

We're building a people-first platform for companies that truly put their people at the center: time, attendance and payroll, designed around the person, not around control.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to be its face in the market. You'll own the client from the first demo to the renewal: you sell, you implement, you make sure people actually use it, and you don't rest until the client wins.

What you'll do

• Lead consultative SaaS sales, demos and pilots with clear success criteria

• Drive implementation and adoption, from signed contract to first clean payroll

• Own retention, renewals and upsell across your client portfolio

• Measure client and employee happiness (NPS) and act on it

• Be the voice of the client inside the product team

What you bring

• 3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or SaaS sales

• A track record of growing users, revenue or retention, with numbers

• Experience with HR tech, payroll, time and attendance or workforce management

• Experience with shift-based operations: manufacturing, logistics or retail

• Professional English and Spanish

What we offer

Base salary plus bonuses for growth, retention and product improvements, with an accelerator for exceeding goals. And the chance to build a brand from day one.

To apply: answer the screening questions and, in your cover message, start with the word MARK and tell us in 3 lines what you've grown and how you measured it.

Ability to translate client business needs into clear internal briefs and explain technical or digital concepts in a practical, client-friendly way. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to keep account plans, opportunity tracking, renewals, and client communications moving forward. Proactive Communicator: Keeps clients, Account Directors, and internal teams informed of opportunities, risks, decisions, and required actions.

Collaborative: Works well across strategy, delivery, technology, design, data, AI, content, and commercial teams to create better client outcomes.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues

Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Buscamos un perfil con mentalidad analítica, alto drive y actitud 100% doer para sumarse a nuestro equipo. En este rol aprenderás y ejecutarás la estrategia de pauta digital de nuestras marcas, interpretando datos en tiempo real y colaborando directamente con creadores de contenido y diseñadores para convertir ideas en resultados de negocio.

¿Qué harás en el día a día? Operación de pauta: Montar, monitorear y optimizar campañas publicitarias en Meta Ads (y Tik Tok Ads / Google Ads según la cuenta). Control de presupuestos: Dar seguimiento diario al gasto para evitar desviaciones y cuidar el rendimiento (CPA, CTR, ROAS). Medición técnica básica: Configurar y verificar enlaces con UTMs, píxeles de seguimiento y eventos de conversión. Análisis y reportería: Elaborar reportes claros de rendimiento orgánico y pagado identificando patrones de comportamiento de la audiencia. Feedback creativo: Detectar qué formatos, piezas y ganchos hooks están funcionando mejor para retroalimentar al equipo de diseño y video. Experimentación con IA: Apoyarte en herramientas de IA (Chat GPT, Claude, automatizaciones) para acelerar análisis, redacción de variantes y pruebas A/B. Experiencia: 1 año gestionando campañas de pauta digital o análisis de redes (se valora experiencia previa en agencia, prácticas profesionales o proyectos propios/freelance). Conocimientos técnicos: Manejo práctico de Meta Ads Manager.

Comprensión de métricas clave: ROAS, CPA, CPC, CPM, CTR y tasa de conversión.

Nociones básicas de Google Analytics 4 (GA4) y embudos de conversión.

ADN y Mentalidad

Gusto genuino por los números, la experimentación continua y la optimización.

Proactividad para proponer cambios y solucionar incidencias sin esperar instrucciones paso a paso.

Buena comunicación para explicar métricas complejas de forma sencilla. Puntos extra (Deseable, no excluyente): Experiencia básica en Tik Tok Ads o Google Ads.

Familiaridad con Looker Studio o Metricool.

Curiosidad activa por el uso de IA aplicada a marketing de rendimiento.

description:
We’re hiring a Senior Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager to build smarter revenue processes and shape Viva’s growth priorities with hands-on HubSpot and AI expertise.




Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators, creating meaningful career opportunities for women across Latin America while welcoming talent of all genders. We’re a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents.




Why this role exists

You'll build and improve the systems that connect Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from first touch through expansion. You’ll use data to spot what’s slowing growth, recommend our next growth bets, and work with department heads to implement improvements and track their impact.




This is a fully hands-on role with no direct reports.

Own HubSpot and our GTM stack. Manage lifecycle stages and fields, data quality, integrations, conversion syncing with advertising platforms, tool access, and costs.

Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.




Who you are

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
You’ve built or significantly improved RevOps systems and processes (0-1 and 1-n), with the ability to take work from identifying the problem through implementation.
Hands-on HubSpot expertise, including lifecycle configuration, data governance, integrations, and automation.

Advanced, hands-on AI and automation expertise. You’ve built and deployed workflows that significantly reduce manual work and expand what you can deliver independently, while validating accuracy and results.

Why you'll want this

Viva’s ready for the next stage of growth, and you’ll be a key player, working alongside our Co-CEO and department heads.

You’ll have the autonomy to find our next bets, guide where we invest, and turn insights into action, helping us actually create more career opportunities for women across Latin America.

100% remote work, forever.

Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Para Esto, Necesitarás

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

Cuidamos muy bien de quienes construyen esta historia con nosotros

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

Días festivos locales, respetando la cultura de cada país.

Horarios flexibles, con hasta 2 horas de flexibilidad al inicio o final del día.

Programas de desarrollo: Ruta de Carrera, Universidad Skeelo y reconocimientos internos.

Día libre durante el mes de tu cumpleaños.

Licencia de maternidad y paternidad según la legislación local.

title: Senior Lead Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations (ALL CLOUDS)
skills: Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.
Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.
Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.
Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.
Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.
8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.

Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About The Role

The Senior Lead Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

Note: By applying to this Senior Lead Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations role your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

What You'll Be Doing

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery


Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.


Strategic Partnerships & Tooling


Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.


Technical Expertise & Incident Response


Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.
Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.
Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications


8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)


Preferred Qualifications


Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.


What's in It for You

You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. This role offers real influence: your field experience will directly inform how migration tooling evolves, and your work will be visible across the business.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Location

Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.
Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.




How we hire




A focused process: application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

title: Coordinador De Comunicación
description:
Vinte es una Inmobiliaria Mexicana con 22 años de operación en el sector y comprometida con la generación de valor para sus clientes, colaboradores y accionistas. Contamos con el Distintivo Empresa Socialmente Responsable 2025. La operación de Vinte comprende toda la cadena de valor del negocio de vivienda, incluyendo la adquisición de los terrenos, urbanización, diseño, construcción, equipamiento y comercialización de viviendas, así como la promoción de vida en comunidad. ¡Suma tu talento a una de las Super Empresas Top Companies 2025 En nuestro equipo, innovar inspira, la pasión nos mueve, la trascendencia nos guía y la pertenencia nos une.Únete al equipo Vinte como: Coordinador de Comunicación Objetivo del puesto: Planear, coordinar y ejecutar estrategias de comunicación interna y externa que fortalezcan la imagen institucional de Fundación Vinte y sus programas. Funciones del puesto: Desarrollar, coordinar e implementar planes y campañas de comunicación, tanto propias como subcontratadas con agencias, alineados a los objetivos de la fundación. Generar contenido gráfico y audiovisual (posts, videos, infografías, etc.) para visibilizar los programas de la Fundación en medios digitales y tradicionales. Administrar perfiles institucionales en redes sociales, página web y plataformas para monitorear su alcance, interacción y crecimiento. Coordinar entrevistas, coberturas de eventos y ruedas de prensa, así como redactar boletines de prensa, notas informativas y comunicados oficiales para dar a conocer lo que está haciendo la Fundación. Redactar discursos, mensajes oficiales y materiales informativos, asegurando la coherencia y el uso correcto de la imagen institucional. Elaborar reportes de actividades, memorias institucionales y presentaciones, con el fin de tener una comunicación institucional efectiva. Buscar la participación en foros nacionales e internacionales, con el fin de darle visibilidad a la Fundación. Administrar los presupuestos asignados a los proyectos, asegurando su eficiencia. Generar convenios de colaboración con una temática de medios de comunicación con autoridades municipales, empresas, y OSC, con el fin de generar contenido y posicionar a la fundación. REQUISITOS: Escolaridad: Lic Comunicación Experiencia: 4 años en puesto afín Experiencia en relaciones públicas, manejo de redes sociales y medios digitales Experiencia en Fundaciones OFRECEMOS: Sueldo competitivo + Atractivo paquete de prestaciones Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional Si consideras que cuentas con todo lo necesario para postularte, aplica ahora. En Vinte podrás vivir una experiencia profesional excepcional, donde podrás desarrollar tu potencial, y a la vez contribuir a que nuestras comunidades tengan una vida como debería ser la vida.

description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

What You Will Do


Lead the execution of catalog and PDP optimization across an entire brand portfolio or client category. 
Architect scalable listing frameworks that reflect marketplace SEO, UX best practices, and real conversion drivers. 
Manage promotional planning and ensure PDP content, pricing, and inventory align with promotional timelines across sales channels. 
Partner with clients and internal teams to design and implement strategic upgrades that improve catalog health and retail readiness. 
Identify systemic listing or promotion issues and build clear remediation playbooks the team can run with. 
Guide junior team members in advanced PDP optimization, promotion scheduling, and retail readiness diagnostics. 
Serve as the go-to subject matter expert on content strategy and promotional enablement for marketplace growth
Partner with media teams to monitor campaign pacing, spend, and performance against KPIs. 


What You Will Bring


3+ years of experience in in eCommerce, retail operations, or digital marketing preferred, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. 
Experience with both Amazon and Walmart retail media ecosystems and best practices. 
Experienced in catalog architecture planning and SEO-focused enhancement strategies. 
Experienced designing promotion strategies for both event-based moments and evergreen programs. 
Deep knowledge of Seller Central/Vendor Central content workflows and best practices. 
Experienced partnering with Media and Creative to ensure PDPs are truly “launch ready.”
Experienced Velocity super-user (or similar internal tooling) for content scoring and tracking. 
Experienced using Excel and Looker/Looker Studio dashboards to monitor content performance and surface clear next steps. 
A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value. 
A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel. 


What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

description:
We’re looking for experienced marketing leaders in roles such as Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, Marketing Director, Growth Marketing Leader, or CMO who have built B2B marketing functions, led marketing teams, and owned end-to-end marketing strategy and execution, with a strong focus on SEO and demand generation.




Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. We're a globally distributed team of 240+ people across 16+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LatAm.




Why this role exists

Viva’s gearing up for its next growth phase. We need you to build our marketing function from the ground up and improve/accelerate the sustainable pipeline of qualified buyers that drives more revenue.

This is a build-and-lead seat: you’ll set the strategy, get it moving yourself, then hire and coach the team that runs it. If getting into the weeds makes you excited, this is your seat. If being a player-coach does not excite you, or being the player until you hire the team to coach, this is not the role for you.




What you’ll do

Two numbers you'll be measured on: Inbound calls booked and Inbound closed-won deals.

Define and lead marketing strategy. Decide where we place our next bets and where we don’t: focus, channel mix, budget allocation, quarterly rocks. ← This is the 1st problem you'll own.
Execute the strategy. Once you build the plan and identify the processes, tools, and support needed, make it happen and use results to decide what to improve next. ← This is the 2nd problem you’ll own.
Build the team. Hire, develop, and coach the team you need to deliver results (e.g., SEO, content, design, link building, etc), and vendors where/if it makes sense.
Connect marketing to business outcomes. Plan OKRs with leadership, define success metrics, and track progress so everyone has a clear view of what it will take to see results.
Own our narrative. Shape Viva’s story, messaging, and positioning so the right buyers understand why Viva, why our services, and why now.
Drive cross-functional alignment. Work with both Co-CEOs and leaders across Sales, Customer Success, People, and RevOps to keep priorities aligned, keep HubSpot lead reporting accurate, and diagnose funnel issues together.




Who you are

You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.
You’ve owned SEO end to end and scaled it from 1 to N, and built other channels such as events or paid ads from 0 to 1.
You’ve hired, coached, and developed marketing teams, and managed external vendors and agencies.
You’ve generated qualified pipeline for B2B companies with $100K+ ACV.
You’ve marketed to US executive buyers, ideally C-suite, VP, or Head-level, at tech companies from scale-ups to enterprise.
Executive-level English (C1+). You keep up in fast-paced conversations with executives, clearly explain your decisions and the reasoning behind them, and negotiate trade-offs and how plans move forward.




Why you’ll want this

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.




Benefits

We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.
Comprehensive global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Family-friendly policies, including parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

With a 4.7/5 Glassdoor rating, we're proud of the experience we create for both our candidates and our team.




How we hire

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → assessment debrief → final interview




All Viva communication will come from an @execviva.com email. If you receive messages from unofficial sources (for example, Instagram or Facebook), please report them to careers@execviva.com. We never request payments or personal information from candidates.
